chunks: In the copy of al-Ṣafwānī: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ḥanān ibn Sadīr, from Fulayḥ ibn Abī Bakr al-Shaybānī, who said:

By Allah, I was indeed sitting with ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, and his children were with him, when Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī came to him. He greeted him, then took the hand of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام and withdrew with him, and said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله informed me that I would meet a man from the people of his Household called Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, whose kunyah would be Abū Jaʿfar. So when you meet him, convey to him my greetings.

He said: Jābir departed, and Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام returned and sat with his father ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام and his brothers. When he had performed the Maghrib salat (prayer), ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn said to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام: What did Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī say to you? He said: He said that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: You will meet a man from the people of my Household whose name is Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, whose kunyah is Abū Jaʿfar, so convey to him my greetings.

So his father said to him: Glad tidings to you, my son, for what Allah has singled you out for through His Messenger from among your household. Do not inform your brothers of this, lest they plot against you as the brothers of Yūsuf plotted against Yūsuf عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: the kunyah of Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ: the Prophet’s household, referring to Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.إِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ: the brothers of Yūsuf, cited as an example of familial plotting
key_terms.السَّلَامَ: the greeting of peace conveyed from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبَ: the Maghrib salat (prayer), after which the conversation continued

ai.seo_question: How did Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh convey the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله greeting to Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration relates Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī conveying the greetings of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله to Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir عليه السلام, as foretold by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله. It highlights the special rank of Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام within Ahl al-Bayt and reflects the care of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام in guarding this distinction.
